_meta.doc: Legacy entry id (PLAYERS, DEFENSE, and OL key-list names as ol-key:<unitId>:<index>) → nflverse person. personId: real GSIS id (00-XXXXXXX) > PFR id > other nflverse id > nv:<slug>:<birthdate> (roster-only people) > unmatched:<slug>. method name+team+season / alias = found on that franchise's roster in that decade; name-only = person exists but never on that franchise in that decade; unmatched = no nflverse person. flags: ambiguous, homonym-resolved-by-position, position-mismatch, zero-seasons, not-on-franchise-in-decade, not-a-person, same-person-as-key-<i>.
